activity_summary: The afternoon was the Knave, and you were not cast. You stood at the tiring-house door. The plot gave no name of a part, and you did not add one. You brought no account of the play away with you.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Stood at the door, and left when it was done.

entities.name: the Knave
entities.context: Mentioned in The door, and not the plot
